{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Verify the number of unique patient IDs
unique_patients = df['patient_id'].nunique()

# Check the distribution of patient_id to confirm duplicates
patient_id_counts = df['patient_id'].value_counts()
duplicate_patients = patient_id_counts[patient_id_counts > 1].index.tolist()

# Print unique patient count and confirm duplicates
unique_patients, duplicate_patients[:5]  # Show first 5 duplicated patient IDs"}
